title: Revision — Earth, Moon, and the Sun
key_ideas: You might have also noticed that the Sun rises in the East and sets in the West.
 In India, sunrise first occurs in the eastern part and then in other parts.
While rotating on its own axis, the Earth also revolves around the Sun as we learnt in Grade 6.
Every evening the Sun sets in the westward direction and the night sky becomes visible.
I have noticed that we go through a cycle of seasons every year.
p Day and night cycle, seasons, the life on the Earth...
At certain times, the Moon can come in between the Sun and the Earth in a way that obstructs the light from the Sun from reaching us.
As the Moon revolves around the Earth, sometimes the Earth can block the sunlight from reaching the Moon.
